title: The Miner's Price
logline: A miner shows up late with a diamond. The merchant who waited all day is not in the mood to haggle.

setting.style: small rustic village, oak and cobblestone

characters.name: Bram
characters.voice_desc: tired middle-aged man, slow, gravelly, low

characters.name: Ola
characters.personality: impatient, sharp, curious when money is near
characters.voice_desc: brisk adult woman, crisp, slightly nasal, quick

scenes.title: Late
scenes.summary: Bram walks into the square at sunset. Ola has been waiting by her stall and lets him know it. He shrugs it off.

scenes.title: The price
scenes.summary: At the well Bram shows the diamond. Ola names a price. Bram sprints off with it instead.
